Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X Barratt Redrow bought 3,064,786 ordinary shares for cancellation during 26–30 October 2026 under its £386 million buyback programme, paying VWAPs of 328.0113p (26 Oct), 334.2437p (27 Oct), 329.9442p (28 Oct), 321.0559p (29 Oct) and 323.6630p (30 Oct) for a total Disclosure Period spend of approximately £10.03 million; to date the Company has repurchased 40,155,719 shares (≈2.93% of issued share capital), all cancelled, leaving 1,370,364,534 ordinary shares in issue and no shares held in treasury. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 02 November 2026 2 November 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 26 October 2026 to 30 October 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE").
